notes.title: Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.content: [p]We will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025 from Thursday, September 25, 2025, to Sunday, September 28, 2025![/p][p]A trial version of "Ending the Happy Route" will be available, so please come and try it out![/p][p]We will also be giving out novelty items![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574706/2fdf67b61f3153906d31a4f836c0085aa9dab1b8.png"][/img][/p]
